fit_reason: Whole 2016 Ford Explorer Police Interceptor offered by a private seller; detailable vehicle. Transmission issues are outside our scope.
findings: Brown speckled spots and grime across the white hood and front bumper
Dirty, dull finish on the rear hatch and rear quarter panel
Dust and grime on the dash, center stack and steering wheel
Bottles, wrappers and debris on the passenger floor mat
Worn, dusty driver seat bolster and soiled front seat covers
Dirty carpet and dust in the rear footwells and on the rear seat
Faded black lower bumper trim and wheel arch cladding
message: Hi, we saw your Explorer listing on Marketplace. The photos show spotting and grime across the hood and front bumper, plus dust on the dash and some trash on the passenger floor. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to where the car is parked, inside and out. Would you like a quote?
